fixed_statement:
Let $\beta>\sqrt{3}$. Use the opened embedded Moebius band asserted in Lemma 4.2.

There exists a continuous map $f:\Sigma\to\mathbb{R}^3$ satisfying both realization conditions.
fixed_proof:
Claims 4.3.1, 4.3.2, and 4.3.3 are exactly the ingredients asserted in the source for producing a realizing map.

By taking a sufficiently fine locally finite $G_\beta$-invariant clean triangulation of $\Sigma$, and scaling the embedding slightly so that the boundary strictly contracts to a length just below $2\beta$ while the internal thickness pushes out to ensure all cross-edges strictly exceed their domain lengths, one obtains a continuous map $f:\Sigma\to\mathbb{R}^3$ satisfying both realization conditions.
